name: Mac fleet service qualification

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/macos-fleet-qualification]

permissions:
  contents: read

# Exactly one isolated job. This workflow never contains Windows/release siblings
# and never changes the production Verify routing variable.
jobs:
  swift-build:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(format('["self-hosted","macOS","ARM64","osvox-macos-qualification","osvox-run-{0}","osvox-attempt-{1}","osvox-host-{2}"]', github.run_id, github.run_attempt, vars.OSVOX_MACOS_QUALIFICATION_HOST)) }}
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      QUALIFICATION_HOST: ${{ vars.OSVOX_MACOS_QUALIFICATION_HOST }}
      QUALIFICATION_CASE: ${{ vars.OSVOX_MACOS_QUALIFICATION_CASE }}
    steps:
      - name: Verify isolated SDK and host selector
        shell: bash
        run: |
          /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, sys
          assert os.environ['QUALIFICATION_HOST'] in {'mini', 'studio'}
          assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 14, 7)
          assert not os.path.exists('/Users/osborn')
          assert not os.path.exists('/Volumes/AIMATE_WORK')
          PY
          xcodebuild -version
          swift --version
          printf '%s\n' 'import Foundation' 'print("ISOLATED_SWIFT_SDK_OK")' > /tmp/osvox-qualification.swift
          swiftc -warnings-as-errors /tmp/osvox-qualification.swift -o /tmp/osvox-qualification
          /tmp/osvox-qualification

      - name: Qualification payload
        shell: bash
        run: |
          /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -u - <<'PY'
          import os, sys, time
          case = os.environ['QUALIFICATION_CASE']
          assert case in {'success', 'failure', 'cancel', 'crash', 'registration-loss', 'api-outage'}
          print('QUALIFICATION_ENTERED ' + case, flush=True)
          if case == 'failure':
              sys.exit(37)
          if case in {'cancel', 'crash'}:
              time.sleep(300)
          PY
